posts.headline: Fifteen editions running and Thicks is STILL 3-0 at 403.68 points — the lowest total among the unbeaten, proving a championship ring buys you nothing but my continued suspicion.
posts.detail: Tyrique14's Klint's Clipboard owns the league's only title but a career record that's dead even at 14-14 with an average finish of 5.5 — until the points-for catches up to the record, this is a coronation I refuse to hand out.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 20-8 career mark and 1.5 average finish is now officially the most false advertising in Busters Anonymous history at 0-3.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra has the best pedigree numbers in the whole league on paper, yet adambarner111 sits winless with 348.4 points — somewhere there's a 1.9 GPA joke writing itself alongside this GM collapse.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is still the league's floor, and the 233.78 points confirm Pharaoh23 picked the hard way on purpose.
posts.detail: At 0-3 with a career 10-average-finish and a league-worst scoring total, Auntie Thomas's reunion tour just added another tour date nobody asked for.

posts.headline: Sasinci's 2-1 start is cute, but Big Head's 13-15 career mark means the Milk Man jokes are staying right where they are.
posts.detail: Alxgalvn has a title banner somewhere in that enormous head, yet a 5.5 average finish says Saso needs way more than 387.28 points through three weeks to silence this column.

posts.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin hits double digits of plague editions, and 0-3 with 329.04 points is starting to feel like scripture written in advance.
posts.detail: BigBoiEmos' BIBLE OR THE BELT carries a modest 13-14-1 career mark, but drafting a defensive player first overall was the original sin — this winless start is just the wages thereof.
